v5.f_q_unit_note: The optimizer and the aggregator KEEP the library caliber (formula-spec 8.17-10): f_q is the zero-squint library quantity, NOT the descriptive f_Q_deliv variant (which has no STR domain -- STR delivery is the library floor 2.4669 m and a task-level parameter request raises). The registered fulfillment ratio is a DIFFERENT reading: per served task, the ACHIEVED-window f_q divided by the best f_q over ALL of the task's windows (each window at its zero-squint best), with no reachability filter -- a <=1 ratio averaged over the served tasks of a tie-set member and then over ALL tie-set members (scripts/build_sweep_results.py:75-88) -- not the anchor solution's reading. Raw f_q is an absolute, non-normalised quantity; cross-family and cross-caliber mixing is forbidden. Any fulfillment-ratio reading must carry the three-part tag (library caliber + tie-set member mean + reported reading, not an optimization target).
